rationale: 'All printed reports' chooses every program that prints ACCT-NO-O (data-dictionary Appendix A). CBL0006 also prints it but its PROGRAM-ID maps to two source files (CBL0006.cobol, CBLC1.cobol), so it cannot appear in programs[] and is a question. The masked format (what replaces the first 4 characters of the 8-byte ACCT-NO-O) is new behavior the ticket does not give. High: PII handling changes. PII: ACCT-NO is PII = Yes. The program set is the scored reference for Jaccard only.
